capabilities: Open a continuous, editable journal timeline built from existing daily notes
Navigate to any date, jump back to today, or open a random past day
Search and filter journal entries by tags and property values with include and exclude rules
List files created or edited on each day alongside that day's note
Show writing statistics such as a year mosaic and new-word counts
extras: README states the plugin works locally, makes no network requests, and requires no account; detailed documentation lives in a separate guide linked from the README.
intentEvidence: Journal View works with your existing notes and daily-note settings—no plugin-specific formats, duplicate files, or lock-in.
problem: Daily notes are separate files, so reading across days and writing today means switching between files, views, and editing modes.
summary: Scrollable, editable timeline view of daily notes with date navigation, search, tag and property filters, and writing statistics.
